decision_conditions: Condition : 0 - It is considered that the continued use of the premises as a control centre for taxi hire operations, with no customer waiting facilities, drivers' facilities or collection point, for a limited two year period, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 445b Great West Road, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties or to local traffic and parking conditions. On balance, the development is in accordance with policies ENV.1.1 New Development, ENV-P.1.5 Noise Pollution, T.1.4 Car & Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments and T.4.4 Road Safety, of The London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan Adopted December 2003. It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 23/02/06 when the use shall cease.
Condition : 2 - The use as a control centre for taxi hire operations, with no customer waiting facilities or collection point, shall be carried on only by Mr A Waheed.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on between the hours of midnight and 0700 hours.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall not be used as a customer waiting area or collection point.
Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and the premises, and in the interests of road safety and to safeguard the amenities of adjoining occupiers, in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development, ENV.P.1.5 Noise pollution, T.1.4 Car & Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments and T.4.4 Road Safety.
Condition : 5 - The premises shall not contain a drivers' rest room or any other facilities for drivers.
Condition : 6 - The display of advertisements for the taxi operations shall not take place outside the building known as 445b Great West Road.
description: Continued use of premises as a control centre for taxi hire operations for a limited two-year period
